verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v1: ʿaraftu biʾanna ʾustādhī ʿaliyyā tawassaʿa fī l-ʾatiyyī wafī l-ʾabiyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v2: wakāna l-ḥibru fī naẓmi wanathri yuzawwidu kulla ʾayyāmi biziyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v3: ʾidhā mā qīla yawmā wāḥakīmā tasābaqati l-ʿuqūlu ʾilā ʿaliyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v4: tashabbaha bībni ʿammi l-badri ḥattā ghadā baʿda t-tashabbuhi kas-samiyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v5: wadhāka bimā lahu min ḥubbi quṭbi jalīli l-qadri dhī karami ṣafiyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v6: wawārathihi ʾabī bakri waman lī bkhayri ʾabi waṣiddīqi wafiyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v8: wakuntu lahu ḥabībā bal ṣadīqā biẓilli l-ʿilmi ʾaw fī kulli ḥayyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v9: jazāhu llāhu ʿannī kulla khayri mattaʿahu biriḍwāni n-nabiyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v10: ʿlayhi ʾālihi maʿ kulli ṣaḥbi salamā rabbinā l-muʿṭī l-ghaniyyī
verses.araftu-bi-anna-ustadhi-aliyyan-c1-v7: wanāla mina l-khalīfati mā tarammā ʾilā l-ʾaqdāri min nashri waṭayyī
